answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one orchard weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The nectar report publishes the merge explicitly at each beacon. Because of that, anyone who spins up 155 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 90 times the capital for one share. A farm of 4461 identities would post 1774 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
